inputs.name: Query
inputs.value:
// Slowest pages 
// What are the 3 slowest pages, and how slow are they? 
pageViews
| where notempty(duration) and client_Type == 'Browser'
| extend total_duration=duration*itemCount
| summarize avg_duration=(sum(total_duration)/sum(itemCount))/1000 by operation_Name
| top 5 by avg_duration desc
| project URL = operation_Name, avg_duration_sec = avg_duration
